records.label: cyber

records.label: cyber
records.why: On Yahoo announcing its email service was hit by the 'Yamanner' worm—arriving in a message titled 'New Graphic Site' that infects the device the moment it's opened (no attachment step) and self-propagates through the victim's contacts—Yahoo advising users to update antivirus/firewall software and not open messages from the named address (email worm).

records.label: cyber
records.why: On WhatsApp disclosing a critical vulnerability (CVE-2022-36934, CVSS 9.8) already patched in new versions—an integer-overflow flaw letting attackers run malicious code via a spoofed video call (RCE enabling spyware install and privilege-escalation)—plus a second flaw (CVE-2022-27492, 7.8) triggered by a malicious video file, affecting older versions (vulnerabilities).
